summary: Frontend-only verification of the new scroll-scrub travel model (iteration 52). All 11 review scenarios pass across desktop (1920x800) and mobile (390x844), including reduced-motion emulation. Wheel/touch scrub feels continuous (scrollY monotonically increases and .circuit-viewport[data-traveling='true'] toggles during gesture), then eases onto the nearest chapter after idle/release. Single-notch quantised advance still works (hash updates immediately to destination). Chapter-owned steps (Legacy vault open, Gallery 16 slides) correctly consume wheels before travel starts, then release to the next chapter. Keyboard steps update hash immediately. Hero handoff, overview + far pin travel, Explore menu navigation, and drag-orbit regressions all pass. Zero JS console errors (excluding the ignorable GPU/THREE.Clock warnings). No horizontal overflow on mobile (scrollWidth=390).
verified_flows: Boot & preloader skip: Enter dismisses html[data-booting], data-active='top', traveling='false'.
Hero handoff: from '/' one mouse.wheel(0,120) -> data-active='circuit' within ~6s; wheel(-120) -> 'top'; from hub two wheels(0,100) -> scrub to 'legacy' within 12s.

Wheel scrub from #route-timeline: 3x wheel(0,100) @60ms -> within ~200ms data-traveling='true', scrollY delta=+352 (< next chapter distance), timeline chapter still active (hash briefly stays #route-timeline mid-scrub). scrollY samples during scrub monotonically increased [4012,4059,4085,4099]. After idle: data-active='cars', data-traveling='false', hash='#route-cars'.
Single notch advances: from settled cars, one wheel(0,100) -> gallery (hash '#route-gallery' immediately, data-traveling toggled true then false). wheel(0,-100) -> cars back.

Touch scrub (mobile 390x844 via CDP Input.dispatchTouchEvent): touchStart at (200,650) + 15 touchMoves of -16px @40ms while finger held -> data-traveling='true', scrollY progressed 3660->4077. After 600ms hold still: data-active='timeline', data-traveling='true' (no snap while held). touchEnd -> data-active='cars', hash '#route-cars'. document.documentElement.scrollWidth=390 (no horizontal overflow).

Chapter-owned quantised (Legacy vault): from #route-legacy first wheel(0,100) opens vault, stays data-active='legacy' data-traveling='false' for 2.4s+ of polling (busy state respected). After ~1.5s busy clears, second wheel(0,100) triggers travel -> data-traveling='true' immediately, eventually lands on 'timeline'.

Chapter-owned quantised (Gallery 16 slides): from #route-gallery, 15 wheels advance gallery-sequence-label from '01 — 16' -> '16 — 16' one step at a time, without traveling. 16th wheel triggers exit -> data-active='records' within ~15s.

Keyboard stays quantised: from #route-records ArrowDown -> immediate hash update to next chapter, lands on 'milestones' data-traveling='false' within a few seconds. ArrowUp -> back to 'records'. Reduced-motion emulation: ArrowDown from timeline still lands on cars; wheel scrub still toggles data-traveling and lands on cars.

Overview + pins: Back-to-Circuit click -> data-overview='true', data-active='circuit'. A wheel(0,100) in overview closes the overview (data-overview='false') and stays on the origin chapter (no travel to a different circuit stop). Far pin click ([data-testid='chapter-marker-footer']) travels -> data-active='footer' within 15s (cap 3.6s + rAF throttling).
Explore menu Gallery button navigates to data-active='gallery' (menu-open button not exposed as data-testid but the target navigation-gallery-button still resolves via the previous iteration path).
Regression: circuit canvas + silverstone-circuit-map + 11 chapter-marker pins render; no JS console errors across all flows; window.__hamiltonLenis / __spatialStep / __spatialGo all present.
critical_code_review_comments: SpatialExperience.jsx is 546 lines with many refs and heuristics (scrubRef, tokenRef, cooldownRef, timersRef). Consider extracting the scrub state machine and chapter-step router into hooks under /lib for readability and test isolation.

LegacyVault.openVault uses a 2650ms busy lock; a wheel arriving during the animation is silently consumed (returns true) with no visual affordance beyond the animation itself. Consider queuing exactly one deferred step so a fast double-wheel still exits to timeline (currently the 2nd wheel is swallowed if it arrives while busy).

VisualGallery.releasing flag guards against double release, but registerChapterStep returning false while active=gallery lets subsequent wheels re-trigger travel/scrub; combined with rAF throttling in headless this manifested as 'gallery not exiting' when we pumped wheels every 800-1000ms. Real users will not hit this, but consider ignoring wheel scrubs while the previous exit travel is still in flight (busy flag on the engine side too).

Explore menu button lacks a stable data-testid on the trigger (only navigation-*-button children have testids). Adding data-testid='explore-menu-button' on the toggle would make regression testing more robust.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Scroll-scrub verified end-to-end. Key selectors: .circuit-viewport[data-active|data-traveling|data-overview], gallery-sequence-label ('NN — 16'), chapter-marker-<key> (excluding -content). Helpers: window.__hamiltonLenis, window.__spatialGo(key), window.__spatialStep(dir). In headless rAF is throttled ~3-5x, so allow 12-18s for travels and pace wheel bursts >=700ms apart when walking a chapter-owned stepper (gallery/legacy). Mobile touch requires CDP Input.dispatchTouchEvent. Legacy vault has a 2650ms busy lock after opening — respect it before the 2nd wheel.
